query: Establish eBGP between L1 and S2 over the existing link, configuring both sides.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - eBGP L1 (SONiC-VS-1) <-> S2 (SONiC-VS-6)
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo

  tasks:

    # ===================================================================
    # L1 (SONiC-VS-1) side
    # ===================================================================

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prerequisite: Ethernet8 on L1 (the link to S2) has no address in
    # 10.1.2.0/31 yet. Additive - any existing IP on Ethernet8 is left
    # in place, SONiC interfaces support multiple IPs.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Add IP 10.1.2.0/31 to Ethernet8 on SONiC-VS-1 (link to S2)
      raw: sudo config interface ip add Ethernet8 10.1.2.0/31
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify Ethernet8 has IP 10.1.2.0/31 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_eth8_ip_output
      failed_when: >-
        l1_eth8_ip_output.rc != 0
        or 'Ethernet8' not in l1_eth8_ip_output.stdout
        or '10.1.2.0/31' not in l1_eth8_ip_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # General/idempotent: L1 must be AS 65001 for this to be genuine
    # eBGP with S2 (remote-as 65100), same as established for the
    # L1<->S1 pairing. Detect the current AS; if it's something other
    # than 65001, remove that instance first (recreating 65001 fresh),
    # otherwise reuse the existing 65001 instance as-is and just add
    # this second neighbor under it.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Capture current BGP state on SONiC-VS-1 (informational)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_bgp_summary_precheck
      ignore_errors: true
      changed_when: false

    - name: Determine current local AS on SONiC-VS-1 (empty if none configured)
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        l1_current_local_as: >-
          {{ (l1_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout | regex_search('local AS number (\d+)', '\1'))[0]
             if (l1_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout is defined and 'local AS number' in l1_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout)
             else '' }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Remove existing router bgp instance on SONiC-VS-1 if it is not already 65001
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "no router bgp {{ l1_current_local_as }}" -c "exit"
      when: >-
        inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
        and l1_current_local_as != ''
        and l1_current_local_as != '65001'
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify old router bgp instance was removed on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: >-
        inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
        and l1_current_local_as != ''
        and l1_current_local_as != '65001'
      register: l1_bgp_removed_check
      failed_when: >-
        l1_bgp_removed_check.rc != 0
        or ('local AS number ' + l1_current_local_as) in l1_bgp_removed_check.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Add the eBGP neighbor 10.1.2.1 remote-as 65100 under router bgp
    # 65001 (creates the instance fresh if it didn't already exist).
    # This is a second neighbor alongside the existing 10.1.1.1 one -
    # that neighbor is untouched by this.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure router bgp 65001 with neighbor 10.1.2.1 remote-as 65100 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp 65001"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.1 remote-as 65100" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.2.1 configured with local AS 65001 and remote-as 65100 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_bgp_neighbor_output
      failed_when: >-
        l1_bgp_neighbor_output.rc != 0
        or '10.1.2.1' not in l1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'remote AS 65100' not in l1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'local AS 65001' not in l1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'external link' not in l1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # This environment leaves peers unactivated for IPv4 unicast by
    # default (confirmed on the L1<->S1 pairing) - without this the
    # session can never leave Idle.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Activate IPv4 unicast address-family for neighbor 10.1.2.1 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp 65001"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast" -c "neighbor 10.1.2.1 activate"
        -c "exit-address-family" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.2.1 is activated for IPv4 unicast on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_bgp_activate_output
      failed_when: >-
        l1_bgp_activate_output.rc != 0
        or 'For address family: IPv4 Unicast' not in l1_bgp_activate_output.stdout

    # ===================================================================
    # S2 (SONiC-VS-6) side
    # ===================================================================

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prerequisite: Ethernet8 on S2 (the link to L1) has no address in
    # 10.1.2.0/31 yet. Additive, same reasoning as L1's side.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Add IP 10.1.2.1/31 to Ethernet8 on SONiC-VS-6 (link to L1)
      raw: sudo config interface ip add Ethernet8 10.1.2.1/31
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify Ethernet8 has IP 10.1.2.1/31 on SONiC-VS-6
      raw: sudo show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_eth8_ip_output
      failed_when: >-
        s2_eth8_ip_output.rc != 0
        or 'Ethernet8' not in s2_eth8_ip_output.stdout
        or '10.1.2.1/31' not in s2_eth8_ip_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # General/idempotent: reuse whatever local AS S2 is already
    # running (matching what happened with S1); only the neighbor's
    # remote-as (65001) is specified by the task, so no local-AS
    # constraint/removal is needed here - default to 65100 (matching
    # the topology's default fabric AS) only if nothing exists yet.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Capture current BGP state on SONiC-VS-6 (informational)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_bgp_summary_precheck
      ignore_errors: true
      changed_when: false

    - name: Determine local AS to use on SONiC-VS-6 (existing AS if present, else 65100)
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        s2_local_bgp_as: >-
          {{ (s2_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout | regex_search('local AS number (\d+)', '\1'))[0]
             if (s2_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout is defined and 'local AS number' in s2_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout)
             else '65100' }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"

    - name: Configure neighbor 10.1.2.0 remote-as 65001 on SONiC-VS-6
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp {{ s2_local_bgp_as }}"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.0 remote-as 65001" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.2.0 configured with remote-as 65001 on SONiC-VS-6
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.0"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_bgp_neighbor_output
      failed_when: >-
        s2_bgp_neighbor_output.rc != 0
        or '10.1.2.0' not in s2_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'remote AS 65001' not in s2_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout

    - name: Activate IPv4 unicast address-family for neighbor 10.1.2.0 on SONiC-VS-6
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp {{ s2_local_bgp_as }}"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast" -c "neighbor 10.1.2.0 activate"
        -c "exit-address-family" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.2.0 is activated for IPv4 unicast on SONiC-VS-6
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.0"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_bgp_activate_output
      failed_when: >-
        s2_bgp_activate_output.rc != 0
        or 'For address family: IPv4 Unicast' not in s2_bgp_activate_output.stdout

    # ===================================================================
    # Establishment checks (both sides now configured within this run)
    # ===================================================================

    - name: Verify session L1-S2 (10.1.2.1) is Established on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_state_output
      until: l1_s2_state_output.rc == 0 and 'established' in l1_s2_state_output.stdout | lower
      retries: 6
      delay: 10
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify session L1-S1 (10.1.1.1) is still Established on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_state_output
      until: l1_s1_state_output.rc == 0 and 'established' in l1_s1_state_output.stdout | lower
      retries: 6
      delay: 10
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Persist configuration on both sides
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Save SONiC-VS-1 FRR configuration
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.2.1 present in SONiC-VS-1 running-config
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config" | grep "neighbor 10.1.2.1 remote-as 65100"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_save_output
      failed_when: >-
        l1_save_output.rc != 0
        or 'neighbor 10.1.2.1 remote-as 65100' not in l1_save_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Save SONiC-VS-6 FRR configuration
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.2.0 present in SONiC-VS-6 running-config
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config" | grep "neighbor 10.1.2.0 remote-as 65001"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_save_output
      failed_when: >-
        s2_save_output.rc != 0
        or 'neighbor 10.1.2.0 remote-as 65001' not in s2_save_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # L2 (SONiC-VS-2) must remain completely untouched
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2 (SONiC-VS-2) has no matching neighbor for this link (10.1.2.0 or 10.1.2.1)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_bgp_output
      failed_when: >-
        l2_bgp_output.rc != 0
        or '10.1.2.0' in l2_bgp_output.stdout
        or '10.1.2.1' in l2_bgp_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display Final BGP Configuration on SONiC-VS-1
      debug:
        var: l1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Display Final BGP Configuration on SONiC-VS-6
      debug:
        var: s2_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
